configuracion.ventana.descripcion: Customize how TecNet Finder starts, its visual theme, interface language, and typography.
configuracion.ventana.inicio.descripcion: Defines the state used when TecNet Finder starts and no previous window state is being restored.
When there is no previous state to restore, TecNet Finder will start using all available space.
configuracion.ventana.estado.descripcion: Restore whether TecNet Finder was maximized or in window mode when the previous session ended.
configuracion.ventana.estado.recordar.ay: Half-screen and full-screen remain temporary states and are not restored between runs.
configuracion.ventana.tema.descripcion: Select a mode first and then a variant. Error, warning, and diagnostic colors always keep their meaning.
configuracion.ventana.idioma.descripcion: Select the language used by TecNet Finder text. The reserved words IP, MASK, HOSTS, and NAME never change.
configuracion.ventana.tipografia.descrip: Change the font used by the general interface. The editor keeps its own independent settings.
configuracion.ventana.configuracion.desc: Return directly to the last category you were viewing the next time you open Settings.
configuracion.ventana.configuracion.reco: Open Settings in the last visited section
